description: Growth Marketing Manager — Enterprise About The Role We are an enterprise AI company selling to large, regulated businesses with long sales cycles and multi-person buying committees. Marketing here runs on named accounts rather than broad campaigns, and every claim we make carries a number behind it. This role owns the execution engine underneath that: demand generation, the marketing technology stack, performance marketing, search and answer-engine visibility, developer and customer marketing, and the reporting that proves any of it worked. It is a hands-on role in a small team — you build these systems yourself. WHAT YOU WILL DO? Demand generation inside account plays. Build and ship the landing pages, sequences, personalised outreach and targeted social that account-based plays require, against a single list shared with sales. Own the martech stack end to end. CMS and hosting, GA4 and Tag Manager, CRM and marketing automation, attribution, SEO tooling and dashboards — selection, configuration, integration, access and cost. Website operations and technical SEO. Site and landing page builds, architecture, structured data, redirects, page speed, indexation. SEO and AEO. Own organic visibility, and build the tracking for how often we appear in AI-generated answers to buyer questions. This part has no established playbook. Performance marketing. Paid social to named buying-committee roles, retargeting and paid search — small budgets, tight tests, honest reporting. Developer marketing. Run the developer-facing surface with engineering — documentation and sandbox operations, sample repositories, technical content programming, developer events and hackathon presence, and adoption measurement. Customer marketing. Own the reference programme with sales — case studies, verified reviews on marketplaces andreview platforms, logo permissions, advocacy and reference calls. Events and community. Executive dinners, conferences, sponsorships and an invitation-only practitioner circle — logistics, follow-up and attributed pipeline. Reporting. One dashboard, one source of truth, reported weekly on pipeline influenced and accounts moved rather than lead volume. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR? 3–4 years in growth marketing, demand generation or marketing operations. Early-stage startup experience strongly preferred someone who has built a function, not inherited one that already ran. Hands-on across a modern martech stack — you have configured analytics and tag management, built automation workflows and shipped CMS pages yourself. We care that you have wired tools together, not which brands you used. Real technical SEO ability — audits, structured data, internal linking, redirect strategy, and confident use of crawl and keyword tools. Performance marketing you ran personally, with a view on what small B2B budgets can and cannot buy. Strong with spreadsheets, dashboards and light no-code automation. SQL is a bonus, not a filter. Comfortable with technical audiences and with customers — you can brief engineers on developer content, and ask a live customer for a case study or a review without flinching. Clear written English, and the judgement to start from context rather than a brief. Willing to be measured on pipeline influenced. BONUS POINTS B2B enterprise or regulated-industry experience Account-based marketing Developer marketing or technical community work An informed opinion on how large language models surface brands Enough HTML and CSS to unblock yourself Exposure to both Indian and international markets. Apply with a page you shipped end to end, a dashboard you built, and one campaign that did not work and what you changed because of it. Skills:- B2B Marketing, growth marketing, Demand generation, account based marketing, enterprise marketing, Marketing operations, martech stack management, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Marketing Automation, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), marketing attribution, pipeline analytics, Content Management System (CMS), technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimisation, structured data, schema, website performance, page speed, paid search, Search Engine Marketing (SEM), paid social, performance marketing, Retargeting, Landing page optimization, marketing campaign, account nurturing, Pipeline & Revenue Attribution, Marketing Dashboards, Reporting, Developer Marketing, Technical Content, Developer Community, advocacy, Case Studies, Customer References, No-Code Automation and Data Analysis
title: Growth Marketing Manager - Enterprise

description: A Snapshot of Your Day We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Product Owner to join our Grid Automation Portfolio Development team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for defining, prioritizing, and delivering innovative software solutions for substation automation. You will work at the intersection of business strategy, customer needs, and technical execution, ensuring our products meet market demands and contribute to the evolution of modern grid infrastructure. A typical day for the Product Owner of Substation Automation Software is a dynamic blend of strategic oversight and hands-on execution. Your morning often begins with a daily scrum with your agile development team, clarifying user stories for complex features like IEC 61850 implementations or cybersecurity requirements. The rest of the morning might be spent engaging with global stakeholders, from gathering customer feedback on a new prototype to collaborating with the service team on deployment pain points. You could be immersed in backlog grooming , meticulously prioritizing upcoming features and assessing technical feasibility with lead engineers, or preparing for an upcoming sprint review to showcase delivered value. Throughout the day, you'll dedicate time to continuous learning through market research on smart grid technologies and competitor analysis, while also fostering seamless integration points by syncing with other Product Owners within the broader Grid Automation Portfolio. How You’ll Make An Impact Manage and groom the product backlog, ensuring it is well-defined, prioritized, and ready for development sprints aligning with the overall grid automation portfolio strategy and company objectives. Technical consulting to the others inc. partners, internal stakeholders and customers Translate strategic goals into actionable product initiatives and epics. Gather, analyze, and prioritize detailed product requirements from various stakeholders (customers, sales, engineering, service, regulatory bodies). Define user stories, acceptance criteria, and use cases, ensuring clarity and completeness for the development team. Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the agile development teams. Actively participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives) to provide guidance and clarify requirements. Monitor development progress, address impediments, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software. Validate developed features against defined requirements and ensure they meet acceptance criteria. Collaborate closely with other Product Owners within the Grid Automation Portfolio to ensure seamless integration and alignment across the portfolio. Gather feedback post-launch and iterate on product improvements based on customer usage and market response. What You Bring Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field. Several years of professional experience in engineering of HMI/ SCADA systems for control systems and energy transmission & distribution Deep knowledge in HMI software applications and Substation Automation software like WinCC, Zenon, ZEE600, SICAM PAS, SICAM A8000 or similar. Knowledge of different vendors solutions is advantage Knowledge of cybersecurity principles as applied to critical infrastructure. Certifications in Product Ownership (e.g., CSPO, PSPO) or Agile methodologies. Familiarity with modern grid automation concepts, smart grid technologies, and industry trends. Proven experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to balance technical details with strategic business objectives. Proactive, self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Fluency in English (additional languages, especially German, are a plus).
title: Product Owner - Substation Automation Software

description: Growth Marketing Manager – PW Skills & PW Institute of Innovation (IOI) Location: Bengaluru | On-site Function: Marketing – Growth Experience: 4–7 Years Employment Type: Full-time About PW PhysicsWallah (PW) is one of India's leading education companies, building technology-led learning and career platforms at scale. Through PW Skills and PW Institute of Innovation (IOI) , we are creating new pathways for students and professionals to build future-ready skills and careers. We are looking for a Growth Marketing Manager who can build and scale growth engines across both businesses, combining performance marketing with organic growth, experimentation, lifecycle marketing, and strong data-driven decision-making. Role Overview As the Growth Marketing Manager , you will own the end-to-end growth funnel across PW Skills and PW IOI — from demand generation and acquisition to conversion, enrolment, and retention. This role is ideal for a full-stack growth marketer who goes beyond media buying and can build scalable, low-CAC growth channels through SEO, content, communities, referrals, creators, CRM, and experimentation. You will work closely with Performance Marketing, Sales/Admissions, Product, Brand, Content, Design, and Analytics teams and will have direct accountability for growth metrics and business outcomes. Key Responsibilities 1. Acquisition & Performance Marketing Develop and execute acquisition strategies across Google Ads, Meta, YouTube, UAC/App campaigns, PMax, and emerging digital channels. Own CAC, ROAS, lead quality, conversion, and enrolment targets across PW Skills and PW IOI. Build acquisition strategies for both self-serve/counselling-led and high-consideration admissions funnels. Identify and test new channels including affiliates, education platforms, creators, campus activations, and offline initiatives. Optimise media spends based on performance, cohort quality, and revenue contribution. 2. Organic Growth & Growth Hacking Build scalable organic acquisition through SEO, content, YouTube, short-form video, ASO, and other relevant channels. Develop referral, community, and student ambassador programs to drive low-CAC acquisition. Build and scale WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, and other community-led growth initiatives. Develop creator and influencer partnerships through barter, affiliate, and revenue-share models. Conceptualise and execute rapid growth experiments such as calculators, career tools, quizzes, challenges, UGC campaigns, and interactive experiences. Establish measurable KPIs for every organic growth initiative and track its contribution to leads and enrolments. 3. Funnel & Conversion Optimisation Own the complete growth funnel from lead → qualified lead → counselling/application → enrolment/purchase . Identify funnel drop-offs and develop initiatives to improve conversion at every stage. Drive CRO across landing pages, application journeys, forms, and checkout flows. Plan and execute structured A/B tests across creatives, messaging, landing pages, and user journeys. Work with Brand, Product, Design, and Content teams to improve messaging and conversion architecture. 4. Lifecycle Marketing & CRM Design and optimise lifecycle journeys using platforms such as MoEngage, CleverTap, WebEngage , or equivalent. Build journeys for lead nurturing, counselling reminders, drop-off recovery, re-engagement, upsell, and cross-sell. Develop audience segments based on user behaviour, intent, demographics, and funnel stage. Create differentiated communication strategies for students, parents, freshers, and working professionals. 5. Analytics, Attribution & Reporting Own growth measurement across GA4, AppsFlyer/MMP, CRM, lead-scoring, and attribution systems . Ensure accurate tracking and attribution across paid and organic channels. Monitor and report key metrics including CAC, CPL, conversion rate, ROAS, LTV, payback, and enrolment contribution. Build weekly and monthly growth reviews with actionable insights and recommendations. Forecast lead, application, and enrolment volumes in line with business and admissions targets. Analyse cohorts and funnel performance to identify opportunities for growth and efficiency. 6. Team & Stakeholder Management Manage a small team of growth/performance marketers and/or agency partners. Set clear targets, monitor performance, and ensure timely execution of growth initiatives. Collaborate with Sales/Admissions, Product, Brand, Content, Design, and Analytics teams. Present growth performance, insights, experiments, and future plans to leadership. Drive a culture of experimentation, accountability, and data-driven decision-making. What We're Looking For 4–7 years of experience in Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing, Digital Growth, or a similar role. Proven experience managing growth with direct revenue, conversion, or enrolment accountability . Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4 , and preferably AppsFlyer or another MMP. Experience with at least one CRM/lifecycle platform such as MoEngage, CleverTap, or WebEngage . Experience managing significant digital marketing budgets with clear CAC and ROAS ownership. Strong understanding of full-funnel marketing, conversion optimisation, cohorts, LTV, and payback. Demonstrated experience building at least one organic or low-CAC growth channel such as SEO, referrals, community, creator-led growth, or viral products. Strong experimentation mindset with hands-on experience in A/B testing and growth experiments. Experience working with high-consideration, counselling-led funnels and/or transactional digital funnels. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert data into actionable growth strategies. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Good to Have Experience in EdTech, Higher Education, Upskilling, Consumer Internet, or D2C businesses. Experience in launching or scaling a new product, category, or institution from 0→1 . Exposure to offline/ATL campaigns and digital attribution. Working knowledge of SQL and analytics platforms such as Looker, Power BI, or Metabase . Understanding of parent-influenced decision-making and student acquisition in the Indian education ecosystem. Experience building student, alumni, creator, or community-led growth programs. What Success Looks Like In this role, success will be measured by your ability to: Scale qualified demand while maintaining healthy CAC and ROAS . Increase the contribution of organic and low-CAC acquisition channels . Improve lead-to-enrolment conversion across the funnel. Build scalable growth loops through SEO, communities, referrals, creators, and lifecycle marketing . Establish a strong culture of experimentation and data-driven decision-making. Deliver measurable and sustainable revenue/enrolment growth for PW Skills and PW IOI .
